name: consistency-tracker
description: Personal consistency, streak, study progress, and goal tracking.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @consistency-tracker/api" "npm run dev -w @consistency-tracker/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @consistency-tracker/shared && npm run build -w @consistency-tracker/api && npm run build -w @consistency-tracker/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @consistency-tracker/shared && npm run typecheck -w @consistency-tracker/api && npm run typecheck -w @consistency-tracker/web
